function.description: Writes a range of characters from a character array to the text stream. It handles temporary and final output states differently, normalizing characters if necessary and tracing the event if a tracer is set. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

ch.description: The character array from which a range of characters will be written. This is Java Array type parameter in string representation. The list elements are of type char; they are not in string representation.

start.description: The start index in the character array from which to begin writing characters. This is Java integer type parameter in string representation.

length.description: The number of characters to write from the character array. This is Java integer type parameter in string representation.
